ISRO plans seven launches this fiscal year, next in two months

The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has announced plans for seven rocket launches within the current fiscal year. The agency's chairman stated that the next mission is scheduled to take place within the next two months. This indicates continued activity and development in India's space program.
